desc: Send when an active Cox carrier network outage is confirmed.

title: Meraki Switch Down RS Side
body:
Dear {{Customer_Name}},

This is Lexter with the RapidScale Alerting team. We regret to inform you that our Managed Network Support team has lost visibility to the network switch SW3 (MS125-24P) located at {{Full_Address}}.

At this time, we are actively investigating the issue to determine the root cause. If you are aware of any site work or power outages that could affect your services, please let us know by replying to this email.

As a first troubleshooting step towards restoring your switch device, we kindly ask that you perform the following steps:

Unplug the power cable from the back of the switch (SW3).

title: Meraki Switch Offline Follow-Up
desc: Send as a follow-up email when a Meraki switch remains offline and unreachable.
body:
Dear {{Customer_Name}},

This is Lexter following up regarding your Meraki switch at {{Full_Address}}. The device is still showing as offline and unreachable on our end.

Please let us know if this is due to an intentional shutdown or scheduled site maintenance. If you require our assistance with troubleshooting, please reply directly to this email or call us at 866-686-0328.

Best regards,

Lexter Rodelas
RapidScale Network Support Team
866-686-0328 | support@rapidscale.net
